counting_rule: Graded alerts: one exchange market-window identifier overall, regardless of stream or repeated delivery. Per-stream views count that market once in each originating stream and are not additive. Earliest originating alert determines the epoch. All losses are retained. Conflicting grades, if any, are counted as losses and flagged. Pending alerts are separate. Executed results: production filled orders only, matched independently to settlement by stream, market and side; repeated order IDs are collapsed. Net after fees is shown only for the current run (since the signal update). Earlier-run dollar amounts are not published. Skips, rejections and unfilled orders never count as trades. Epochs use entry/alert time, not settlement time; post-update including post-restart is also shown as a cumulative subtotal.
